title: Required fields present boolean contract
failure_signature: model emits required_fields_present as a list of field names
model emits required_fields_present as a string or object instead of a boolean
prompt_delta: required_fields_present is a boolean status field. Emit exactly true when all required fields are present. Do not emit a list of field names in required_fields_present.
validator_expectations: required_fields_present must be true when all required fields are present
